, a reanimated undead dragon.]] Undead dragons are dragons that were reanimated after death. They include zombies, ghosts, and animated skeletons. The Lich King's Scourge contained a great number of them in the form of frost wyrms.
Underwater Breathing is a passive undead racial trait. Since the undead are not alive, they can breathe underwater. This effectively makes a Forsaken's breath last for 10 minutes.

The Undead Slaying sets can be found during the original Scourge Invasion occurring in patch 1.11. They have been replaced with the Blessed Undead Slaying sets seen in patch 3.0.2. There are four sets, one for each armor type. The gloves of each set are sold by the Argent Dawn in exchange for thirty Necrotic Runes. The bracers are Bind on Equip and are dropped by rare spawns at the Necrotic Shards. The chest pieces are Bind on Pickup and dropped by Shadows of Doom which spawn when you disrupt the shard. * Regalia of Undead Cleansing (cloth) * Undead Slayer's Armor (leather) * Garb of the Undead Slayer (mail) * Battlegear of Undead Slaying (plate)
Undead Slayer's Armor is the leather anti-scourge set from the first scourge invasion.

Under the Shadow is one of the Scourge Invasion quests. This quest must be completed in order to purchase items in exchange for Necrotic Runes from any of the Argent Quartermasters at Light's Hope Chapel or the Argent Dawn camps found in capital cities.

The Undercroft is a crypt in the southwestern region of the Eastern Plaguelands. It is home to a band of undead trolls who are led by the undead dire troll Zaeldarr the Outcast. He leads occasional raids on the Argent Dawn's base at Light's Hope Chapel to steal bodies from their grave pit. It is also the location of Tirion Fordring's ersatz grave.
__NOTOC__ Undertaker Mordo is a Forsaken quest giver located at the Deathknell Graves southwest of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
While associated with the Rewriting the Battle of Darrowshire quest chain (Classic), this quest is not a required part of it.
The Undelivered Parcel is provided upon the acceptance of The Writhing Deep (quest).

Underfoot is a house cat who is seen chasing Spike around the Blacksmith in Arathi Basin. Underfoot and Spike appear only when the Horde claims the Blacksmith area for the Defilers. The Alliance counterpart of Underfoot is Lady who is seen chasing Cleo around when the League of Arathor controls the Blacksmith area.

The Underlight Mines are a small cluster of mines in the Ghostlands, located just west of Bleeding Ziggurat and north of the road between Tranquillien and Windrunner Village and Windrunner Spire. The mines are home to an ore known as Underlight Ore, which can be mined there or found in the pockets of the local gnolls, the Blackpaw clan, who have overrun the mines. Deathstalker Maltendis would like to see them removed. The blood elves have an interest in the area, as Underlight Ore may well be useful in the battle with the Scourge.
Underspore Frond is a quest item contained in The Underspore behind Hungarfen in the Underbog.
Underspore Pod is a type of food which restores both health and mana.
The Undead Ravagers was a subdivision within the undead Scourge led by a lich that attacked Hearthglen.

The Underblade is a demon cult in the far reaches of the Ashenvale Forest. Underblade cultists have a small tattoo of a dripping dagger inked onto the heel of the right foot.
Undermine Clam Chowder is created with Cooking (225); taught by Recipe: Undermine Clam Chowder.

Under the Burning Sky is the Chapter 8 and the final chapter of the Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos undead campaign, Path of the Damned.
The Undead Warlock was an action figure released by , along with the Tauren Shaman and the Jungle Troll Voodoo Priest.

Underwater Construction Workers could be found working around one of the Stormwind canals on a project to build a new road to the Stormwind Harbor. They worked with Construction Workers and Dwarven Construction Workers under the supervision of Foreman Wick and Mason Goldgild. Goldgild and Wick report to Baros Alexston.

The Underbelly (or the Dalaran Sewers) is the name of the Dalaran sewer system which has its own separate map. Many races, but mostly goblins, dwell in these sewers and they could be viewed as the slum of Dalaran. The central area of the sewers is the Circle of Wills, a large hall in which the arena vendors, some dueling circles, and a small, currently unused cluster of buildings stand. Southwest of here is a section called Cantrips & Crows which contains the inn, the tavern, and the bottom exit pipe of Dalaran. The northeastern corner goes unnamed, and has a few vendors but not much else notable. Finally, further northeast, there is a small chamber in which the rogues of Dalaran operate the

Undead beasts are a unique category of hunter pets introduced in patch 9.0.1. They are not a standalone pet family, but rather a range of appearances spread across several different families. These creatures are normally classed as undead NPCs but become beasts when tamed. Only Forsaken hunters can tame undead by default; hunters of other races must learn the skill from a Simple Tome of Bone-Binding. Note that there are many types of untamable undead animals as well as animals who look like undead creatures but are classified as normal beasts. These are not included in this article.
Undead Slayer's Blessed Armor is the leather anti-scourge set from the second scourge invasion.
Underbelly Elixirs are found scattered throughout the Underbelly of Dalaran.
Underbelly croc is visible near the entrance to the Black Market. At the entrance, if the player goes to their left, they will see a grate, with the Underbelly croc behind it.

Uncut is a jewelcrafting term referring to raw gems that can be cut by the jeweler to create gems that can be socketed in player equipment. Examples of uncut gems include Golden Draenite, Living Ruby, Chalcedony, Dragon's Eye, to name a few.

The Undermarket are cutthroat traders who will sell, move, trade and do just about anything for the right price. They have recently set up a base of operations in the Searing Gorge. Trade Master Kovic is the head of the local group and has ties to the Dark Iron dwarves. Nilith Lokrav had the members in the area killed.
Underbelly Rats are rats that have adapted to living in the Dalaran sewer system.
__NOTOC__ Undead Dynamiters are ghouls that can be found in the pre-instance part of the Deadmines in Westfall.
Undead Excavators are ghouls found in the pre-instance part of the Deadmines in Westfall.
Underbog Lurkers are level 61-70 fungal monsters found in the Underbog.

Underlight Canyon is an intensely purple-blue chasm full of exotic plant and aquatic life directly west of the Seabrush in Abyssal Depths. Large eels, groupers and coldlight murlocs can be found here. L'ghorek can be found on the western border of the canyon. Brothers Humphrey and Oskar Digsong as well as Orako can be found near the entrance to the canyon, closest to the Scalding Chasm. Underlight Canyon2.jpg Underlight Canyon3.jpg
Underlord's Mandible is a quest reward from Ix'lar the Underlord (quest).
Underlight Phosphora drops from the following creatures in the Abyssal Depths: *Pyreshell Scuttler *Luxscale Grouper
Underlight Nibblers are looted from the same-named NPCs in the Abyssal Depths.
Undead Slayer is a PvP guild achievement requiring an honorable kill on all Undead classes.
Undermine Remnant is sold by Vinny Slapchop after the dragon has appeared on Kezan.

; Hungarfen : Hungarfen is an oversized bog giant with two bog giant guards. When pulling these guards, be careful as they pull together. Once his two guards are cleared and Hungarfen is engaged, underbog mushrooms sprout in numerous, random locations on his platform and explode after a few seconds for stacking area effect nature damage over time. At approximately 15% to 20% health, Hungarfen shields himself with a wall of roots, causing all melee attacks to heal Hungarfen for about 5% of his maximum health each. ; Ghaz'an : Ghaz'an spits acid in his forward arc for substantial area of effect damage. His tail lashes out and care should be taken to avoid being kicked off of the platform. Ther

Uncle Eastwind is a grummle found at Kota Basecamp in Kun-Lai Summit.
